name: Moulin Rouge, La Goulue
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Moulin Rouge, La Goulue” by Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1891), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 82287. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
